title: Recording, mixing: Jazz Street by Wings | 1972
content:
Studio One, AIR Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Bill Price

Wings recorded the unreleased song ‘Jazz Street’ on 27 November 1972 at AIR Studios in central London.

‘Jazz Street’ was a piano-led jam lasting almost eight minutes. It had Paul McCartney on piano, Henry McCullough on electric guitar, Denny Laine on bass guitar, Denny Seiwell on drums, and Linda McCartney on percussion.

Paul overdubbed a synthesizer part and backwards guitar, but after mixing the results it was decided to take the track no further.
